questions.q: What are the main ways to invest in real estate?
questions.why: Buying property directly, or buying property funds or REITs.

options: A company or fund owning rental property, traded like a share
questions.why: A company or fund that owns income-producing property and trades like a share.

options: It is slow and costly to sell
questions.why: It can take months to sell, and buying and selling have high costs.

questions.q: What ongoing costs come with a rental flat?
options: Maintenance, repairs, taxes, insurance, empty months
questions.why: Maintenance, repairs, taxes, insurance and empty months.

questions.q: Why is one flat a concentrated investment?
options: It is spread across many cities
All money depends on one building and place
questions.why: All the money depends on one building in one location.

questions.q: How can a small investor spread property risk?
options: Property funds or REITs with many buildings
questions.why: Through property funds or REITs that hold many buildings.
